summary:
Iter 9 — verifying two recent fixes: (1) Field component in /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx now forwards layout style to the outer Pressable (fixes 'tall empty boxes' bug); (2) invoice PDF item photos + logo embedded as base64 data URIs via photoDataUri() in /app/frontend/src/uploads.ts (fixes missing product photos in generated PDFs). Both fixes CONFIRMED working end-to-end. Backend endpoints referenced in the review request behave correctly.

BACKEND (owner@tredi.app):
- GET /api/settings/invoice returns show_photos, template ('t3'), brand_color ('#014747'), header_color, logo_url, logo_size (90), export_format ('professional'), accounts[3], terms_sets. All fields present.
- GET /api/invoices/{id} returns lines[] with photo_url populated on every line, correctly backfilled from items collection. Verified on INV-1196 whose 'Adeba Rice 50kg' line carries the same photo_url as the corresponding item document (/api/files/tredi/uploads/.../0b77e4b2dccc405e91d5bc71ae1261e5.png).
- Existing pytest regression run on money-model + invoice-templates suites: 17/18 pass. The single failure test_get_returns_new_template_fields is a STALE seed-data assertion (owner's saved template is now 't7' because a prior test iteration saved it, and the test asserts the value is in {t1..t6}). Not a code bug — a test fixture gap. Documented under 'context_for_next_testing_agent'. Owner's template setting was left untouched by this iteration.

FRONTEND (390x844, owner@tredi.app / tredi1234):
- /invoices/new: full flow completes without error — customer picker (Cash sale continue) → Items step (add 'Adeba Rice 50kg' from inventory-pick, item card renders with DISC box, +/- controls) → Review & send.
- Layout audit on the Review step (which uses Field in a side-by-side row): review-due-date outer box height = 43px, review-payment-mode outer box height = 39px. Every Field-based testID on the review card was measured — none exceed 64px, none collapse to 0. Screenshots captured to /tmp/step3_review.png show a normal-height 'Due date | Payment' row (previously ballooned).
- Layout audit on other Field-heavy screens: /stock/new = 8 Field boxes, max height 63px; /expenses/new = 4 boxes, max 63px; /settings/invoice-template = 2 boxes, max 63px. Zero suspiciously tall (>90px) empty boxes on any of the reviewed screens.
- /invoices/pdf/{id} for INV-1196 (line item has a real photo_url): pdf-paper renders with 2 images inside — the first has src starting with 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...' which IS the product thumbnail embedded as a data URI (not a network URL). Confirmed under both Simple and Professional pdf-format tabs. The tredi wordmark is the second image. Zero red screen, zero expo-file-system runtime errors in console.
- Toggling pdf-format-simple ↔ pdf-format-professional is instant and clean.

Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.
action_items: OPTIONAL: /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_templates.py::TestInvoiceSettingsTemplate::test_get_returns_new_template_fields asserts template ∈ {t1..t6}. Because t7 (Professional) is now a valid template that the seeded owner may already have saved from prior UI runs, this test is stale. Either (a) widen the assertion set to include t7, or (b) reset the owner's settings.invoice.template to 't3' in the test's setUp fixture. The user asked us not to modify /app/backend/tests, so flagging only.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx:198 — Field's outer Pressable now correctly receives the caller's `style` prop. Previously the layout style landed on the inner border box, so a caller doing `<Field style={{ flex: 1 }} />` inside a flex row would leave the Pressable at flex:0, letting it collapse and the inner box balloon to fill the row. Fix is minimal, targeted and correct. Recommend adding a JSDoc note (the 4-line comment above lines 194-197 already covers it — nice).

/app/frontend/src/uploads.ts:59-66 — photoDataUri() correctly uses the new expo-file-system File/Paths API for native (import { File, Paths } from 'expo-file-system'; new File(Paths.cache, ...); File.downloadFileAsync; file.base64(); file.delete()). The legacy FileSystem.downloadAsync/readAsStringAsync APIs would throw at runtime in expo-file-system v57. Web branch uses fetch → blob → FileReader which is the right shape for the browser preview. Nice belt-and-braces cleanup at line 64 that swallows a delete() error.

/app/frontend/app/invoices/pdf/[id].tsx:54-58 — useEffect batches all line photo_urls through Promise.all(photoDataUri) into a linePhotos map keyed by url, then line 60 maps inv.lines to replace photo_url with the data URI before handing to buildInvoiceHtml. Good separation: the on-screen preview uses linePhotos[l.photo_url] directly (line 105), while the exported HTML gets pre-substituted URIs. This means the PDF engine never has to make an authenticated request during rasterisation — the root cause of missing photos is definitively fixed.

/app/frontend/app/invoices/pdf/[id].tsx:105 — brand.show_photos && linePhotos[l.photo_url] guard means if the data URI failed to load (photoDataUri returned '') the row simply skips the image instead of rendering a broken <Image>. Good.

success_rate.backend: 17/18 (94%) — 1 failure is a stale test-data assertion, not a code regression
success_rate.frontend: 100% — every reviewed Field renders at normal height (≤63px), PDF item photos embed as data URIs on both Simple and Professional, no expo-file-system runtime errors

seed_data_creation: Temporarily flipped settings.invoice.show_photos ON to exercise the PDF photo path, then restored to false at end of run (matches the value at start of iteration). No new invoices/items created this pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The two fixes described in the review request are verified. Field 'tall empty boxes' bug and PDF 'missing product photos' bug are both closed. Owner's settings.invoice.template is currently 't7' (Professional) — future testing agents running test_invoice_templates.py::test_get_returns_new_template_fields will hit an assertion failure until the test allows t7 or the value is reset in the fixture. Public URL: https://ui-flow-accurate.preview.emergentagent.com. Login: owner@tredi.app / tredi1234 via /sign-in (Skip onboarding first). PDF screen path: /invoices/pdf/{invoice_id}; INV-1196 (id 6aaa374f7b18905bdfc1a833) is a handy test target because its line item has a real photo_url.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no unresolved bugs. Original layout bug RCA: Field's outer Pressable did not receive the caller's style prop, so `<Field style={{ flex: 1 }} />` inside a flex row wrapped an untouched Pressable which shrank to 0 while the inner border box (still styled as before) stretched vertically. Passing `style` down to the Pressable at line 198 fixes it. Original PDF-photos RCA: photoDataUri used expo-file-system legacy readAsStringAsync/downloadAsync which throw at runtime in v57; migrating to the new File/Paths API restores base64 embedding on native, and the Promise.all pre-substitution in [id].tsx ensures the PDF engine never has to fetch a live authenticated URL.
